title: Wireshark Traffic Investigation
story: Students analyze a PCAP file to identify suspicious network behavior and extract attacker information.

tasks.title: Open PCAP
tasks.description: Load the provided packet capture in Wireshark or tshark.
tasks.hint: Open the .pcap file and inspect the packet list.

tasks.title: Filter Packets
tasks.description: Use display filters to narrow the traffic to suspicious conversations.
tasks.hint: Try filters for ip.addr, tcp.stream, http, dns, or ftp.

tasks.title: Identify Attacker IP
tasks.description: Determine which host initiated suspicious traffic.
tasks.hint: Follow streams and compare source addresses.

tasks.title: Detect Protocols
tasks.description: Identify the protocols involved in the suspicious activity.

tasks.title: Extract Credentials
tasks.description: Find any exposed credentials in cleartext traffic.
tasks.hint: Follow TCP streams for HTTP, FTP, or basic auth data.
